methodology.population: Runtime athlete catalog after withRegisteredPhoto/localizeAthlete; missing means !athlete.image
methodology.rank: Production calculateAthleteRanking + sortAthletesByRanking; 1-based within gender among actual ranking members; unranked tail excluded
methodology.score: Unrounded production score; null if unranked
methodology.resultRows: All linked runtime rows including DNS/DNF/DSQ; season from edition.year
methodology.priority: A: rank<=100 OR rows>=5; else B: rank101–300 OR rows3–4; else C
methodology.order: Ascending within-gender rank, MEN first at equal rank; unranked last
methodology.photoValidation: Local path existence and SHA256 only; no visual identity or image-decoding validation; no network requests or importer invocation

analysisCompletion.basis: Existing 2026-09-23 snapshot; no ranking recalculation or external photo research. Recommendations are proposed, not implemented.

firstBatch.selection: Per gender: TOP-100 without image, at least 5 result rows, not in VERIFIED_NO_PHOTO_NAMES; first 8 by rank plus 2 remaining with most result rows (ties by rank).

athletes.selectionReason: two highest result-row counts among remaining eligible; rank breaks ties

firstBatch.acceptance: 20 discovery targets, not 20 promised downloads. All pilot acceptances need manual review; uncertain or unavailable candidates remain unresolved.

workflow.rule: Use runtime athleteId/nameEn and explicit batch manifest. Discover actual source profile URLs; do not treat mechanically constructed URLs as verified.

Verify final URL and source profile identity with stable source ID when available, exact name or documented alias plus corroborating biography/results. Country alone, HTTP 200 and redirects are insufficient.
Prioritize explicit portrait fields of verified profiles. Keep identity confidence separate from image relevance score; no numeric score can override an identity conflict.

Run in every mode before eligibility classification. Reject known placeholders/logos and flag image URLs shared across distinct identities; use persistent corpus beyond the batch. Incomplete corpus means lower confidence.

HIGH requires verified identity AND explicit portrait association AND no conflicts; MEDIUM is manual review; LOW/NO_PHOTO are not download-eligible. Source errors use RETRY/UNRESOLVED, never permanent NO_PHOTO.

Only eligible candidates; separate staging directory; bounded size/time, MIME plus decoder validation, dimensions and checksum. Compare content hashes/perceptual similarities against other identities after bytes are available; return conflicts to review.

Publish only approved staged assets with source URL/profile ID/date/hash/review evidence. Do not overwrite existing/manual assets implicitly; atomic file/registry promotion and explicit rollback manifest.
Pilot manual review of every accepted photo in source context, preview/contact sheet, filesystem/registry/catalog integrity, idempotency, athlete audit, ranking/linkage invariance.

confidencePolicy.HIGH: May auto-accept after pilot gate: independently verified athlete/profile identity, explicit source portrait association, no shared/default/identity conflicts, valid decoded image; preserved evidence. Numeric scoring alone is insufficient.
confidencePolicy.MEDIUM: No production registry write; requires documented review to become accepted. Preview download, if separately authorized, stays in staging and is not an accepted catalog photo.
confidencePolicy.LOW: Do not download or publish; store reason and evidence.
confidencePolicy.NO_PHOTO: Do not download; record verified profile URL and dated absence evidence. Not a permanent ban. HTTP/network errors remain unresolved.

fixBeforeImport: Replace regex source parsing with runtime catalog; regression for Valentina D'Angeli, apostrophes/diacritics and aliases.
Separate normal skip, explicit recheck and cleanup; audit-weak must inspect candidates rather than skip all names.
Make dry-run nonmutating in every flag combination, including clean-no-photo; destructive cleanup explicit and separate.
Require identity/profile and portrait verification before acceptance; explicit HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NO_PHOTO/RETRY outcomes.
Always apply shared-asset checks; add staged downloads, content validation and duplicate-content review.
Preserve manual/existing photo precedence; enforce no-photo policy in one place; avoid reintroduction through registry fallback.
Add explicit batch allowlist, timeouts/retries/rate limits, evidence manifest, atomic publication and idempotency checks.
pilotChecks: Exactly 20 intended athletes, no VERIFIED_NO_PHOTO_NAMES or existing-photo replacements; catalog linkage unchanged.
Manual identity and portrait review for every accepted image; no reliance solely on candidate score.
Every accepted file decodes and exists; all registry paths resolve; no orphan files, slug collisions or unexplained shared hashes.
Dry-run and cleanup combinations do not modify files/registry; repeated approved import is idempotent.
Protect old photo hashes/manual overrides; run audit:athletes, audit:results and git diff --check; compare production ranking order/scores and result linkage at a fixed asOf.
analysisCompletion.scaleGate: No wrong-person acceptance or unresolved conflict among published pilot images; every published image manually reviewed with evidence; data/file checks pass, baseline issues do not grow, no-photo/manual protections and dry-run/idempotency tests pass. Only then expand in reviewed batches of 25–50, preserving abstention. Any wrong identity pauses auto-acceptance and triggers investigation; 20 successes do not prove global precision.
